definitions.explanation: A shortened version of a word, phrase, or name.
The act of leaving out or cutting part of something, such as a portion of text, a step in a process, or a formality.

examples.japanese: 「⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{略|りゃく}だ。

「⟦{国連|こくれん}→国連：12035_kokuren⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{国際連合|こくさいれんごう}→国際連合：18107_kokusairengou⟧」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{略|りゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧だ。
examples.english: "Kokuren" is the abbreviation for "United Nations" and is an organization that maintains world peace and security.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{略|りゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{構|かま}いません。

examples.english: Dear Sir/Madam (letter opening that omits the usual seasonal greeting).

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{略|りゃく}させて→略す：04006_ryakusu⟧⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Due to time constraints, I will omit the detailed explanation.

notes:
An extremely productive word in Japanese. As a standalone noun, it indicates abbreviation or omission. It also appears as a prefix, suffix, and in many compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{略|りゃく}: abbreviation of ~
- ⟦{略|りゃく}して→略す：04006_ryakusu⟧: abbreviated as, shortened to
- ⟦{以下|いか}→以下：01294_ika⟧{略|りゃく}: the rest is omitted
- {中略|ちゅうりゃく}: middle portion omitted
- {前略|ぜんりゃく}: opening greeting omitted (letter writing)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{略語|りゃくご}→略語：21705_ryakugo⟧: abbreviation, acronym
- ⟦{略称|りゃくしょう}→略称：13562_ryakushou⟧: abbreviated name
- ⟦{省略|しょうりゃく}→省略：03244_shouryaku⟧: omission, abbreviation (the more formal compound)
- ⟦{略図|りゃくず}→略図：19705_ryakuzu⟧: rough sketch, simplified map

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{省略|しょうりゃく}→省略：03244_shouryaku⟧: omission — the full compound form, more formal
- ⟦{短縮|たんしゅく}→短縮：13665_tanshuku⟧: shortening, abbreviation — emphasizes making something shorter in length or time
